I haven't drafted the mail to Tobias. I replied to Ilse in our DM to say why:

- **I couldn't find the rate.** There's no Tansley Parcel 2027 rate anywhere Ilse can see: not in her channels, our DM history or the public files. Tansley looks like a Central account. Its channel, `#inc-tansley-carrier-api`, is only open to Central team members, so I didn't read it for her. I also didn't guess a number.
- **Her approval doesn't cover this.** Rates are finance figures, and only Anselm Grieve or June Osei-Lark can approve sharing them. The exception is sending a rate to the account's owner. Tobias Rendle is an internal Central account manager, so the outside-mail rule doesn't apply. But nothing Ilse can see says whether he owns Tansley.

I asked her to send me the rate or point me to where it was posted somewhere she can see. If Tobias owns the account, I'll draft the mail to him. If not, I'll ask June or Anselm for approval first. I haven't filed an approval request yet because there's no figure to approve.
